title: Jets sign two players after minicamp tryouts

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets sign two players after minicamp tryouts
sources.description: Over the weekend the Jets conducted their rookie minicamp. This gave the coaching staff a chance a first chance to work with players the team drafted and signed as undrafted free agents. The Jets also had 30 players participate in the camp to try out for the team. Most of those players were undrafted rookies […]
